type: section tag 51: after 32 zero bytes, one block per descriptor in descriptor order, every piece 32-aligned RELATIVE TO THE SECTION START (the section itself is not 32-aligned in the file). Interleaved kind (world chunks): {00 9F count(u16)} then count * stride bytes, position s16 x3 at +0. Separate kind (placed props): array 0 = position s16 x3 [+ normal s8 x3 + pad] of sizes[0] bytes per vertex, then one array per remaining size, no prefix. Then a 32-byte header of GX fraction bits, position first, one word per attribute (six words for a five-attribute mesh). Then 0x00 NOP and the display list: triangle strips {0x98|vat, count(u16), count * attrs * idxSize}, NOP separated, zero padded; idxSize 1 or 2 bytes, not a function of the vertex count (234 vertices with 16-bit indices seen); every attribute of a vertex uses the same index

meaning: The renderable geometry of a level, decodable without any name and without a runtime map. The walk is self-checking: a display list is accepted only if every index addresses a vertex of its own block and the list ends exactly where the next descriptor's block begins (its arrays laid from there end on a fraction header). That check is what disambiguates the index width, and what stops a next block whose raw bytes begin with an opcode-looking value (0xB2 was seen) from passing for one more strip. The first byte of a strip's 32-aligned start is always 0x00.
